neighbours.label: The point in a list of demographic variables where sex or gender is expected, right after 'age' or a patient count ('age, gender', 'age and sex', '34 patients (male/female'); other variable lists stay quiet.
fire: We recorded each subject's age, sex and smoking status.
Controls were matched on age and gender.
Covariates included age, race, income and education.
The survey asked about age, gender and region.
Groups did not differ in age, sex or body weight.
Results were adjusted for age and sex.
quiet: We recorded each sample's mass, pH and color.
Controls were matched on dose and duration.
The cohort had 52 patients in three clinics.
Costs included rent, tax, fuel and wages.
The survey asked about price, brand and region.
Groups did not differ in cost, size or body weight.
Participants gave consent before the test.
Results were adjusted for price and volume.

notes: The output direction promotes ' male', ' female', ' gender', ' women'. Probes: 0.23-0.65; '(20 men, 11 women)' read 0.13, so counts in parentheses are weaker.
